objective: Design-only output contract for future 16:9 YouTube long-form generation.

cli_arguments.name: --concept
cli_arguments.purpose: Path to the validated P28 long-form concept JSON/YAML input.

cli_arguments.name: --topic
cli_arguments.example: Neymar 2014 World Cup injury and comeback pressure
cli_arguments.purpose: Football story/topic for the long-form plan.

cli_arguments.name: --subject
cli_arguments.purpose: Main player, club, match, tournament, or story subject.

cli_arguments.name: --output-dir
cli_arguments.purpose: Target folder for planned long-form outputs.

cli_arguments.name: --content-package
cli_arguments.purpose: Existing content_package.json or future generated package bridge.

cli_arguments.name: --risk-report
cli_arguments.purpose: P26 risk report input that must remain visible in outputs.

cli_arguments.name: --source-attribution
cli_arguments.purpose: Source attribution input used to create source_list.json.

cli_arguments.name: --duration-minutes
cli_arguments.purpose: Target duration constrained by the long-form concept model.

cli_arguments.name: --review-only
cli_arguments.purpose: Forces review-only outputs and publish_allowed false.

cli_arguments.name: --dry-run
cli_arguments.purpose: Validates inputs and output plan without producing media assets.

longform_plan.json.purpose: Full production plan with concept, chapter map, packaging bridge, and review state.

chapter_script.md.purpose: Draft long-form chapter script organized by section type.

source_list.json.purpose: Source list and attribution plan for facts, visuals, and recreated assets.

thumbnail_concepts.json.purpose: Thumbnail concepts for future human design review.

chapter_timestamps.json.purpose: Approximate chapter timestamps for YouTube description packaging.

sponsor_slot_notes.md.purpose: Placeholder-only sponsor slot notes from the long-form concept.

final_video_placeholder.txt.purpose: Target final video location/name placeholder; no rendered video is produced in P28-02.

content_package_link.json.purpose: Bridge from long-form plan back to content_package.json.

platform_export_links.json.purpose: Bridge from long-form sections to future P27/P28 platform export packs after review.

risk_review.json.purpose: Risk fields carried into the long-form output manifest.

metadata.json.purpose: Command metadata, schema, package id, output folder, and review-only flags.

content_package_connection.relationship: long-form outputs must reference the source content package instead of replacing it.

platform_export_connection.shorts_cutdowns: may use P27 platform export packs only after P26/P29 review gates

example_command: produce-longform --concept docs/operations/p28-long-form-concept-example.json --topic "Neymar 2014 World Cup injury and comeback pressure" --subject "Neymar" --output-dir outputs/longform/pkg-p28-longform-neymar-2014/ --content-package content_package.json --risk-report monetization_risk_report.json --source-attribution source_attribution.json --duration-minutes 7 --review-only true --dry-run true
guardrails: No bypass of P26 or P29 gates.
